0022600191.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (4-4) host the New York Knicks (4-4) in the Cavaliers' 10th game of the season. Cleveland sits 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, and 6th in the East, after losing its last two games, while going 3-1 at home and 1-3 on the road; New York is 7th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, after winning its last two, with a 3-2 home record and a 1-2 road record. The Cavaliers are missing Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), and the Knicks are missing Josh Hart (ankle), and the two teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season. The Cavaliers lost the 2025-26 regular-season series 1-2 and lost the 2025-26 playoff series 0-4, including a 130-93 defeat in their most recent meeting, a playoff game in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
